answer: Cross-Epoch Behavioural Thread Matching. Each agent samples interactions into a per-epoch behavioural thread, and admission at epoch end requires correlation above a threshold with its own prior epochs. A farm of fresh identities starts at the tundra of zero history, so each synthetic persona must run genuine multi-epoch activity to reach even the nadir of the matching band, multiplying cost per identity by the number of epochs enforced before privileges unlock.
